items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: One of them used to play bass. What do you name fell in that hatch? Robay. Robay Chaperon.

ctx.x: No, no. No, not at all. One of them used to play bass. What do you name fell in that hatch? Robay. Robay Chaperon. That's right. Robay Chaperon. Robay Chaperon. Robay. That's right. Well now that's... That hall out there. What they call that... Secret Hot Hall. Secret Hot Hall. Secret Hot Hall.

That's right. Secret Hot Hall. That was out there. Well I'll tell you the trick of me. Butter Bowling was playing and Frank Reducing. And I was sitting down on the side of the... On the side of the plane, you know, I look. I had my mouth open like this. I looked at the plane and after I left the hall, I had so much dirt while the people was dancing.
